teaser: The squeak of sneakers on a gym floor, the ball already in your hands before the whistle finishes. You are a 1, the Leader, paired with an ENTJ, the Commander, and the crossing here is almost redundant: both of you want the same chair. What is particular is not the wanting but the speed of it. You see the shot before the play is called. The question kept alive here is not whether you can lead but what is left over when nobody needs leading.
excerpt: The gate latch at the dog park sticks, and you are the one who fixes it without being asked, already planning how the fence line should run before anyone mentions it needs fixing.
